quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-3 , FlanT5 , and PaLM  have demonstrated exceptional performance across a diverse array of natural language processing tasks within the zero-shot paradigm . Consequently, these LLMs have been adapted for zero-shot document ranking tasks, showcasing remarkable capabilities .
The performance of various approaches is assessed using NDCG@10, which serves as the official evaluation metric for the employed BEIR benchmark.

Pairwise approaches determine the relevance order of two documents for a query at a time, wherein LLMs are prompted with a query alongside a pair of documents to choose the label indicating which document is more relevant to the query, namely Pairwise Ranking Prompting (PRP).
